description: Check the South African case citations and Acts in a piece of text against GetLawED's library of official copies and verified records. Each item comes back as found, found_by_citation (a bare citation with no party names that resolves to a judgment we hold — parties were not compared, so confirm the name in the returned title), mismatch (the citation belongs to a different case), name_only, not_found, repealed or unchecked. "not_found"/"unchecked" means "check the law reports", not "fake".
name: legal_verify_citations
title: Check South African citations
